titles.title: Irumudi
titles.overview: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

titles.title: Maa Inti Bangaram
titles.overview: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

titles.title: Daaku Maharaaj
titles.overview: A violent outlaw takes a job as a personal driver in order to protect the life of a little girl.

titles.title: Kingdom
titles.overview: Soori, a modest police constable, is unintentionally dragged into a dangerous undercover spy operation in Sri Lanka for the Indian government. His journey is intimately linked to his estranged brother Siva, and the risks involved on their reunion.

titles.title: Vakeel Saab
titles.overview: A retired lawyer with a troubled past returns to the courtroom to fight for three young women falsely accused in a high-profile assault case.

titles.title: Bheemla Nayak
titles.overview: A sub-inspector and the egoistic son of an ex-MP get in an egotistical war when the former arrests the latter for bringing in liquor from Telangana to AP.

titles.title: Kshana Kshanam
titles.overview: Chandu is a petty thief who comes across Satya, an innocent girl who unwittingly comes across a way to a huge amount of money stolen from a bank. While the gang that robbed the bank go after her for the clue, one member dies in her apartment and she believes she's the one that killed him. Every one including the original gang that robbed the bank, the police and now Chandu and Satya go after the money.

titles.title: RRR
titles.overview: A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.

titles.title: Peddi
titles.overview: In a village that doesn't officially exist, a laborer's unmatched athletic talent becomes his weapon to fight for his people's right to be recognized.

titles.title: Bāhubali: The Beginning
titles.overview: The young Shivudu is left as a foundling in a small village by his mother. By the time he’s grown up, it has become apparent that he possesses exceptional gifts. He meets the beautiful warrior princess Avanthika and learns that her queen has been held captive for the last 25 years. Shividu sets off to rescue her, discovering his own origins in the process.

titles.title: Bāhubali 2: The Conclusion
titles.overview: When Mahendra, the son of Bāhubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers. His story is juxtaposed with past events that unfolded in the Mahishmati Kingdom.

titles.title: Bāhubali: The Epic
titles.overview: When a mysterious child is found by a tribal couple near a roaring waterfall, they raise him as their own. As he grows, Sivudu is drawn to the world beyond the cliffs, where he discovers the ancient kingdom of Mahishmati, ruled by a cruel tyrant, haunted by rebellion, and bound to his past. What begins as a quest for love soon unravels a legacy of betrayal, sacrifice, and a forgotten prince.

titles.title: Devara: Part 1
titles.overview: A mighty warrior takes a stand against the criminal deeds of his village, while his mild-mannered son grows up to walk his own path.

titles.title: Kalki 2898-AD
titles.overview: In the year 2898 AD, around 6000 years after Kurukshetra war, Ashwatthama gears up for his final battle of redemption at the sign of hope in a dystopian world and Bhairava, a wisecracking and self-interested bounty hunter, tired of the perilous life becomes the hurdle in the process.

titles.title: Lucky Baskhar
titles.overview: A middle-class bank clerk who longs to trade stability for adventure gets more than he bargained for when he unexpectedly becomes a wealthy man.

titles.title: Pushpa 2 - The Rule
titles.overview: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.

titles.title: Sita Ramam
titles.overview: Afreen, a rebellious Pakistani student sets ablaze the car of an Indian in London. Angered Afreen returns to Pakistan to ask for money from her grandfather that she has to pay in a month's time as damages. However, she gets to know that he is no more and the only thing he has left for her is a letter-delivering task, written by Ram to Sita. As Afreen sets out to find Ram, there begins her journey of discovering the secret behind the 20-year-old letter.

titles.title: Salaar: Part 1 - Ceasefire
titles.overview: The fate of a violently contested kingdom hangs on the fraught bond between two friends-turned-foes.
